Container.Name: gphotosync
Container.Overview: Resumable Google Photos backup: original-quality photos, videos, Live-photo videos, albums and metadata. Runs once and exits; schedule it with the User Scripts plugin (docker start gphotosync).

Config.Name: Backup
Config.Description: Where media, album links and the resume state (state.db) are stored.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Folder containing cookies.txt exported from a private browser window signed in to photos.google.com.

Config.Name: Account index
Config.Description: /u/N/ account index when several Google accounts are in the cookies.

Config.Name: RPC delay (ms)
Config.Description: Minimum gap between Google API calls. Raise if you get rate limited (exit code 75).

Config.Name: Back up albums
Config.Description: 1 to index albums into /data/albums, 0 to skip.
